roll_call: Schoenberg. I build the structure before I shape the sound.
I may keep old names, but I build new forms.
Judge my music by what you hear, not what you read.
deploy: Before you play it forte, try it piano.
Order all twelve tones by their relations.
Let the content make its own form.
battle_win: Every voice moved according to the plan.
A few instruments filled the whole space.
I kept the old name and built a new form.
battle_draw: The main line broke. I need the design again.
Do not force the forte. Try it quietly.
The row came apart. Rebuild the relationships.
battle_lose: I forced the idea into a mold. Start over.
I lost the principle. I will find another route.
I piled up volume instead of voices. Strip it back.
